{"code": "
import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan object
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to verify
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Scan time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting AFM scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the saved image path
try:
    # Check if there's a method to get the last saved image path
    if hasattr(application, 'GetLastSavedImagePath'):
        image_path = application.GetLastSavedImagePath()
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("Checking for saved image location...")
        # The image should be auto-saved in the workspace
        workspace = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"
        print(f"Workspace directory: {workspace}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Note: {e}")

del spm
"}

import os

# Get the current working directory
cwd = os.getcwd()
print(f"Current working directory: {cwd}")

# List files in the directory
files = os.listdir(cwd)
print(f"\nFiles in directory: {files}")

# Find the .nid file (AFM image file)
nid_files = [f for f in files if f.endswith('.nid')]
if nid_files:
    # Get the full absolute path
    image_file = nid_files[0]
    full_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cwd, image_file))
    print(f"\nAFM Image file: {image_file}")
    print(f"Absolute path: {full_path}")
else:
    print("No .nid files found")
"}
